_comment: Machine-readable rules per publishing profile. Read by scripts/scaffold_post.py, scripts/check_posts.py, scripts/typefully_drafts.py, and scripts/pull_typefully_edits.py. Prose rules for each voice stay in the style references named under `style`. Find Typefully social set IDs with: python3 .claude/skills/social-content-studio/scripts/typefully_drafts.py --list-social-sets

alexey.label: Alexey Grigorev
alexey._copy_note: Alexey has X Premium. linkedin.md is the one copy for LinkedIn, X, and Substack Notes, so Typefully keeps them in sync.
alexey._variants_note: Each variant is one Typefully draft with the same copy. A variant is created only when the post has every media file it needs. `none` means the platform gets no media in that draft; platforms not listed are left out of that draft. Substack Notes accepts no video (Typefully rejects it), so Substack carries the copy without the clip.

datatalksclub.label: DataTalks.Club
datatalksclub._copy_note: No X Premium. linkedin.md feeds LinkedIn and x.md feeds X as a separate thread, so the platforms carry different copy in the same draft.
